dedupe_keys.name: energy simulation outputs for different mitigation scenarios

description: Shamila Haddad and colleagues publish cooling-load simulation outputs for 3,323 urban buildings in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Nine Excel workbooks represent a reference case and eight combinations of reflective materials and irrigated or dry greenery. The README identifies building ID, floor area, building type, summertime cooling load and annual cooling load. The November 2023 collection is freely downloadable under CC0 and also identifies Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.jsxksn0hb. It can support comparison of heat-mitigation scenarios or checking urban cooling-demand simulations. The values are model outputs, and the public README leaves the weather year, load units and uncertainty unknown. Provider-reported percentage savings were not independently checked. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection or its alternate DOI. The README was read, but no workbook or simulation model was downloaded.
